'''2002 World Championship Top 8 Jonny Chu DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2002 World Championship]] (Top 8), finishing 6th; the list below is from the official Players Committee decklist form.<ref name="src">[http://www.theforce.net/ccg/sw/decks/chuDS.pdf SWCCG Players Committee decklist form: Connect 4]</ref>

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jonny Chu]]
* '''Event:''' [[2002 World Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Finish:''' 6th
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Connect 4
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Source:''' [http://www.theforce.net/ccg/sw/decks/chuDS.pdf PC decklist form]
